title: [RM-900] Expose currency rate age in route summary
author: rcastrejon
body:
Adds a typed helper on the route summary service to report how stale the currency rate is, and surfaces it read-only in the summary serializer. Includes a focused test.

Linear: https://linear.app/reservamos/issue/RM-900
derived_from: Pattern grounded in price-engine-python service/serializer + expects-test conventions; analogous to clean approvals like backend PR 3743/3755.
